_comment: Forbidden path patterns for the eqv2 blind drafting tools (addendum 47, plan-based, exploratory). Static AST scan (blind_audit.py --static) and runtime audit-hook enforcement share this list. Patterns are matched case-sensitively as substrings of the path touched after backslash-to-slash normalisation. The addendum's shorthand items are covered by these path-specific patterns; the substitution (no bare 'graph_'/'ttl' patterns, which would block the allowed snapshot read and unrelated library paths, and no bare '.env' with no leading separator issues) is recorded in frame_summary.json. Second substitution recorded 2026-10-27: the bare job-file tokens listed in 'boundary_patterns' match only at a path-SEGMENT start (pattern at position 0 or right after a '/'), so the forbidden 'job files' rule cannot fire on an unrelated library file whose segment merely contains the token (e.g. site-packages/.../_jobs_api.cpython-312.pyc).
